area_overview: SQL Server database creation and server/database admin basics: CREATE DATABASE syntax, data/log files, master/model/system databases, GO batches, and multi-window/connection behavior.
key_ideas: CREATE DATABASE can define primary data files with ON PRIMARY and log files with LOG ON.
File options include NAME, FILENAME, SIZE, MAXSIZE, and FILEGROWTH.
If a log file is not explicitly specified, SQL Server creates one by default.
master stores instance-level metadata, logins, server configuration, endpoints, and database metadata.
model is the template for newly created databases; customizations in model affect future databases.
GO is a client/tool batch separator, not a T-SQL command sent to SQL Server.
GO separates DDL batches, resets variable scope, and can repeat a batch with GO n.
Different query windows/connections can have different database context and transaction/session state.
